group_normalization: NFC, grouping keys only; source and reference preserved

selection_contract.train: all generative mappings, vocabularies, ngrams and neural weights
selection_contract.dev: context evidence/correction thresholds and neural early stopping/fallback thresholds
selection_contract.calibration: selector training and grouped out-of-fold C/threshold selection only
selection_contract.test: final evaluation after every parameter is frozen; no iterative tuning

limitations: Parent-line groups do not establish manuscript/collection independence because provenance is absent.
A newly repartitioned corpus previously used in development is not a pristine external test dataset.
Trusted segment pairing filters with reference SHAD count; this does not evaluate source-only segmentation or OCR.
